2607.00692.title: Self-GC: Self-Governing Context for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
2607.00692.paper_summary: Long-horizon LLM agents accumulate tool results, files, plans, and user constraints that are too structured to be treated as a disposable text suffix. Current systems mostly rely on in-run heuristics such as chronological pruning and tool-output masking, or on final self-summary near a context limit. Heuristics are cheap but blind to future dependencies; summaries preserve narrative state but often hide exact evidence, locators, and editable artifacts. We present Self-GC, where GC denotes self-governing context while deliberately echoing garbage collection: the system does not merely reclaim unused tokens, but governs the lifecycle of agent context objects. Self-GC turns user turns, tool spans, and skill state into indexed objects; asks a side-channel planner to propose fold, mask, and prune actions; and lets the harness enforce recoverable sidecars, safe commit boundaries, and cache-aware commit. On a 33-session Hard Set, Self-GC prunes 43.95% of prefix tokens while leaving 84.85% of future continuations unaffected, compared with no-impact rates of 54.55% to 69.70% for heuristic baselines. On a 332-session production-derived suite, three planner backbones reach no-impact rates of 91.27% to 94.58%, while baselines remain at 77.71% to 87.46%. In production, an online account-level split reduces daytime average input tokens by 10% to 15%, with peak reductions near 20%. These results point to context management as runtime lifecycle control over indexed, recoverable objects rather than post hoc text cleanup.
2607.00692.paper_summary_zh: 長期視野的 LLM 代理累積工具結果、檔案、計畫和用戶約束，這些都過於結構化，無法被視為一次性文本後綴。當前系統主要依賴於運行中的啟發式方法，如時間順序修剪和工具輸出遮蔽，或在上下文限制附近的最終自我總結。啟發式方法成本低廉，但對未來依賴性視而不見；總結保留敘事狀態，但常常隱藏精確的證據、定位器和可編輯的工件。我們提出 Self-GC，其中 GC 代表自我治理的上下文，同時故意回響垃圾回收：該系統不僅僅是回收未使用的標記，而是管理代理上下文對象的生命周期。Self-GC 將用戶回合、工具範圍和技能狀態轉化為索引對象；請求側通道規劃者提出折疊、遮蔽和修剪行動；並讓鞍具強制執行可恢復的附加物、安全提交邊界和考慮快取的提交。在 33 次會話的 Hard Set 上，Self-GC 修剪了 43.95% 的前綴標記，同時讓 84.85% 的未來延續不受影響，與啟發式基準的無影響率 54.55% 到 69.70% 相比。在 332 次會話的生產衍生套件中，三個規劃者骨幹達到 91.27% 到 94.58% 的無影響率，而基準保持在 77.71% 到 87.46%。在生產中，線上帳戶級別的拆分使白天平均輸入標記減少 10% 到 15%，高峰減少接近 20%。這些結果指向上下文管理作為對索引、可恢復對象的運行時生命周期控制，而不是事後文本清理。
